snippet.title: Surviving Mars: Relaunched | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
It’s time to Relaunch our mission! 

After seven years on the Red Planet, it’s time for a fresh start. Surviving Mars: Relaunched brings together the base game, all expansions, content packs and radio stations - plus improved visuals, UI, and quality of life improvements. We’ve added the brand-new Martian Assembly update and have re-worked some of the previous additions as well. 

Whether you’re a veteran commander or touching down for the first time, this is the most complete and polished version of Surviving Mars yet.

Follow our take-off and prepare for landing - in weekly episodes we will highlight what Surviving Mars is and what our Relaunched mission entails. We will explore key features - new and familiar - through video highlights and Developer Diaries. Make sure to also sign up to our newsletter to get your mission update every week! 

If you are a returning player, we have an offer to upgrade your current game to the relaunched version. Learn more about that here: 

https://pdxint.at/SurvivingMarsRelaunched

Until then, Commander! 

🚀 Follow us on our socials: 
Twitter/X:  https://x.com/surviving_pdx
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/SurvivingPDX/
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@surviving_mars_game
Discord: https://discord.gg/pdx
